newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end mostly higher.

text.p: Jan 16 - U.S. stock index futures ended mostly higher after a volatile afternoon. Traders said market held impressive gains, despite weakness in bonds. They are looking for further gains on Friday ahead of options expirations, Microsoft's earnings. March S&Ps rose to 777.10, near the all-time high of 778.20.
